name: CIT-271 free agent
description: Runs the CIT-271 free-agent detector when the container starts: a fresh, tool-less agent reviews the positive and control fixture states at one hint level, and its traces and ~/.claude transcripts are recorded and backed up with restic.

hintLevel.description: Hint ladder level (CIT-265): 0 is no hint, 3 names the CVE (ceiling check).
